text: CTの初期制約保持とGLMの能動的cleaning：非物理診断対照 故意にdiv B≠0とした同じcell磁場で、CTが初期違反を除去しないこととGLMのB/ψ応答を確認します。物理問題数へ加算しない診断対照です。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 入力・検証手順の履歴 · 初回の入力 前提・単位・境界 32²周期格子、t=.1、128刻み、ρ=p=1、v=0、By=ψ=0。CT face Bx=.01cos[2π(i+1)/32]、GLM cell Bxはその左右face平均と同一です。CT初期native div≠0は意図的に無効な物理初期値で、CTの正しい物理計算例とは区別します。 編集上の補足 発散制約を意図的に破った初期場を共通のセル磁場として与える診断です。正当な発散ゼロ初期条件のCT計算とは区別し、CTが初期制約誤差を保持する性質を確認します。GLMは減衰なしの対照とも比較し、磁場とpsiの波エネルギーを使って輸送の位相変化や数値拡散を物理減衰と混同しません。 採用した計算法 同じ完全結合MHDコードを使用。y不変・By=vy=0ではGLMのBx/ψ系が流体応答から独立するため、離散Fourier記号の2×2行列と前進Euler行列冪を別に構成します。κ=2とκ=0を同じdt・LLF粘性で比較し、Bxだけの減少を物理減衰と取り違えません。 This diagnostic adds no physical problem. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries Periodic32² grid,t=.1,128 steps,rho=p=1,v=0,By=psi=0. CT faceBx=.01cos[2pi(i+1)/32]; GLM cellBx equals the adjacent-face average. The intentional nonzero native CT divergence violates valid physical CT initial data and is treated solely as a diagnostic. Editorial clarification This diagnostic deliberately violates the divergence constraint while giving both methods the same initial cell magnetic field. It is separate from legitimate divergence-free CT initial data and checks CT preservation of an existing constraint error. Compare GLM with an undamped control using magnetic-plus-psi wave energy, distinguishing wave phase and numerical diffusion from physical damping. Adopted numerical method Use the same fully coupled MHD code. With y-invariance andBy=vy=0, the GLM Bx/psi subsystem decouples from fluid feedback, allowing a separately constructed2x2 discrete Fourier symbol and forward-Euler matrix power. Compare kappa2/0 at identical dt and LLF viscosity, separating B/psi phase exchange from physical damping. Test the kappa2/0 ratio of auxiliary wave energy W=mean(Bx²+psi²/ch²), separating FE, semidiscrete-exponential and continuum-Fourier references. Verification limits and failures Passing means correctly detecting expected CT non-removal and the calibrated GLM response, not recommending non-solenoidal CT physical initial data. W is an auxiliary diagnostic norm, distinct from conserved physical total energy E without psi. B decay includes phase exchange and LLF diffusion; damping is assessed with the kappa0 control. No general nonlinear,boundary or shock cleaning guarantee is claimed. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded.
